can

(bewitching
> > oration) thus making the acting methuselah take his vote card back
in
> > his hand and waste his modifier...

I believe so. It could also be played after a bribes, allowing you to
vote for something, gain a pool, and then delay it.

>
> And also can it be use to nullify voter captivation?

No. The Voter Cap must be played after the referendum is successful,
and therefore done.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
inr...@my-deja.com wrote:
> GP...@videotron.ca wrote:
> > > I was wondering if there is a restriction on when delaying tactics
> can
> > > be played...
> > >
> > > can it be played after modifiers to the vote have been set
> (bewitching
> > > oration) thus making the acting methuselah take his vote card back
> in
> > > his hand and waste his modifier...
>
> I believe so.

Correct.

> It could also be played after a bribes, allowing you to

True.

> vote for something, gain a pool, and then delay it.

Not true. You wouldn't gain the pool from Bribes until the
results are tallied (since you are not the Methuselah who
played the Bribes). And you cannot play DT after the
referendum, so you'll have to choose - gain a pool or
cancel the referendum.

> >
> > And also can it be use to nullify voter captivation?
>
> No. The Voter Cap must be played after the referendum is successful,
> and therefore done.

Correct.
